en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a broad European street lined with ornate late-19th / early-20th-century apartment buildings. The main corner building has bay windows, balconies, and a small tower-like roof structure. People in long dresses and hats walk along the sidewalk. Printed titles at the top read "Meissen-R. Kaiserstrasse." and a publisher's line at the bottom reads "7251 Brück & Sohn, Meissen 1908". The word "Modes." (fashion) appears on the shopfront at the street level.
